The '''Lakhasa Caravan''' was a long-running [[Scout/Legends|scout]] organization founded by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Amada Lakhasa]]. The Lakhasa Caravan was well-known in ports across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and they protected their good name vigorously.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
